gov_strip: A digital agriculture initiative · Government of Tamil Nadu (demo)
advisory_1: Water tomato and potato at the base, never overhead — wet leaves invite blight.
advisory_2: Check the undersides of leaves weekly; most diseases are visible there first.
advisory_3: Clear and destroy crop debris after harvest — it is where most fungal disease overwinters.
